title: D-RADI: A Low-rank ADI Algorithm for Solving Large-scale Discrete-time Algebraic Riccati Equations
summary: The low-rank alternating direction implicit (ADI) method is an efficient numerical technique for solving several types of large-scale matrix equations that admit low-rank solutions. The discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation (DARE) is an important matrix equation with applications in state estimation, controller design, and filter design. In the literature, the low-rank Cholesky factor ADI method for Stein equations has been used within Newton iterations to solve large-scale DAREs.
